rationale: Accidental damage to the phone happened on July 13, inside the covered trip (Jul 10-17), and is covered under wording section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects). The repair report (beyond economical repair) and replacement receipt are on file. The Economy per-item limit of $150 applies because there is no Electronics Plus add-on, so $1,099 is capped at $150, less the $100 Economy deductible (wording section 10), giving $50. This is under $1,000, so no sign-off is needed. Manual version 2026.2.
